rows.en:
{C:81931601}{C:81958296F12200000000}Thanks to your efforts,
the excavation of Panzer Blades
is proceeding smoothly.

{C:81958296F22200000000}(Through this conflict,
I should be able to guide humanity's evolution.)

{C:81930C00}{C:81958296F32200000000}I see...

{C:81931701}{C:81958296AF0100000000}You! His Majesty is addressing you in person,
and you dare respond
with such insolence!

{C:81931601}{C:81958296F42200000000}It's all right, High.

{C:81931701}{C:81958296B00100000000}I spoke out of turn.
Forgive me, Your Majesty.


{C:81931601}{C:81958296F62200000000}(I do not know
what you are plotting.

{C:81958296F82200000000}But the longer the conflict continues,
the better it serves my purposes.)






{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190D101}{C:81958296F92200000000}It's a pleasure to meet you, travelers from beyond the Cloud Sea.
I'm {C:819782830400}Quatre Raberba Winner.{C:819782830000}

{C:81958296FA2200000000}Would you let me join you
to fight Posaydal's army?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FB2200000000}That's a very straightforward request.

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296FD2200000000}Considering the movements of Posaydal's army,
we don't have time to take things slowly.
Would you please let me join you?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FE2200000000}What do you think, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296FF2200000000}What do I think...?
What should we do, Nelfea?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296002300000000}Don't pass it off to me.
It all comes down to whether
we can trust him, doesn't it?

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296022300000000}I'll do anything
to earn your trust!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296032300000000}Anything?
Then you can clean the Astante's toilets
for as long as you're aboard!

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296052300000000}...All right.
I've never cleaned toilets before,
but I'll do my very best!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296062300000000}Oh, no, I'm kidding!
The toilet cleaning was a joke!

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296072300000000}A joke...?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296082300000000}Anyone willing to fight alongside us
is more than welcome.
It's good to have you... May I call you Quatre?

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296092300000000}Yes.
I'm glad to be working with you too.



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190D101}{C:819582960A2300000000}From what I've learned,
this land is ruled by 
{C:819782830400}Mardoul{C:819782830000}, who has allied with Posaydal's army.

{C:819582960C2300000000}Mardoul also appears to have ties
to a ship with the same shape
as yours.

{C:81900300}{C:819582960D2300000000}This continent's caught up in it too.
We have to do something, fast.

{C:81930100}{C:819582960E2300000000}(That's right.
There's Lun to think about too.
We have to hurry.)

{C:8190D101}{C:819582960F2300000000}I've heard there are anti-Mardoul forces,
but unfortunately,
I don't know where...

{C:81900400}{C:81958296102300000000}Don't you know anyone
who might know?

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296112300000000}{C:819782830400}Azuves{C:819782830000} is an old knight
I've heard
is leading them.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296122300000000}Azuves...
It looks like we'll have to find him.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296132300000000}For now, let's go
wherever we can.



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930300}{C:81958296152300000000}Do they mean us?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296162300000000}I think so, but ignore them, ignore them.
I'm sure nothing good will come of it.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296172300000000}Agreed. Let's ignore them.

{C:81901C01}{C:81958296182300000000}You there!
Ignoring me only makes you
all the more suspicious!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296192300000000}Oops. That backfired.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900E01}{C:819582961C2300000000}That was a close call.

{C:81900300}{C:819582961D2300000000}Thank you very much.
Um, your name...?



{C:81900E01}{C:819582961F2300000000}This land is ruled
by the Conqueror King, Mardoul.
You would do well to be careful.


{C:81900400}{C:81958296202300000000}Aw, he's gone.

{C:81900D01}{C:81958296212300000000}You silly children.
That was the hero Azuves
you've been looking for.

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296232300000000}It was?!
We missed our chance.

{C:81958296242300000000}Um, where could we go
to meet Azuves?

{C:81900D01}{C:81958296262300000000}Who knows?
There aren't that many places you can go.
You'll have to do your best on your own.




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190D101}{C:819582964F2300000000}Oh, isn't that
Azuves over there?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296502300000000}It is! We did it, Quatre!
We've found Azuves!

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296512300000000}We did.
Let's go speak to him!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296522300000000}Yeah!

{C:81958296552300000000}Excuse me, Azuves!!

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296562300000000}Ah, you're the people from earlier.
What can I do for you?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296572300000000}Are you... Azuves?

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296582300000000}Indeed I am.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296592300000000}We heard you're
with the anti-Mardoul...


{C:81900E01}{C:819582965A2300000000}Ah, that.
Then this isn't the place.
Let's meet aboard your ship.

{C:81930100}{C:819582965B2300000000}Yes.



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900D01}{C:819582965E2300000000}Are you the ones
looking for Azuves?

{C:81930100}{C:819582965F2300000000}Yes, but who are you?

{C:81900D01}{C:81958296612300000000}That doesn't matter.
You want to know where Azuves is,
don't you, boys?

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296622300000000}You know?!

{C:81900D01}{C:81958296632300000000}{C:819782830300}Iron City{C:819782830000} is the other town.
Try going there.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296662300000000}She might be lying.

{C:81900D01}{C:81958296682300000000}What a rude little girl.
Well, whether you believe me
is up to you boys.

{C:81958296692300000000}Do as you please.


{C:81900400}{C:819582966B2300000000}What do we do?

{C:81930100}{C:819582966C2300000000}We have to find him,
so trusting her is one option.

{C:81900400}{C:819582966D2300000000}So we're just making it up
as we go along after all.

{C:81930100}{C:819582966E2300000000}That's right.




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900E01}{C:819582968A2300000000}Ah, you're back.
My apologies for earlier.

{C:819582968B2300000000}The anti-Mardoul forces
are still far too weak.
Too much attention would cause us trouble.

{C:81930100}{C:819582968C2300000000}I'm sorry.

{C:81900E01}{C:819582968D2300000000}No, no, don't worry about it.
Now, why were you
looking for us?

{C:81900300}{C:819582968E2300000000}We came to this continent pursuing
a ship called the Norstan.

{C:819582968F2300000000}We heard it had allied
with someone called Mardoul here...

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296902300000000}You mean to lend us your strength?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296912300000000}Would you
accept us?

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296922300000000}Young people with such honest eyes
are rare in this day and age.
Very well.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296932300000000}Thank you very much.


{C:81900E01}{C:81958296952300000000}Then let me introduce our comrades.
Could you take this ship
to where they are?


{x00}

{C:81900300}{C:81958296962300000000}Yes!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296972300000000}This is all thanks to Quatre.

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296982300000000}We found him
because we all searched together.
I didn't do it alone.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296992300000000}That's not true.
We wouldn't have learned anything
if you hadn't joined us, Quatre.

{C:819582969A2300000000}Thanks, Quatre.

{C:8190D101}{C:819582969C2300000000}Thank you.

I'd like to go as soon as possible.
Please head straight there.


{x00}

{C:81900A01}{C:819582969E2300000000}Welcome back, Grandpa.
Huh? Who are they?

{C:81900E01}{C:819582969F2300000000}Ah, Jojo.
These people will fight Mardoul
alongside us.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296A02300000000}Really, Grandpa?!
All right!
I'll go tell everyone!!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296A12300000000}He's an energetic boy.

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296A32300000000}My grandson's name is {C:819782830400}Jojo.{C:819782830000} Now,
shall we go to the square?



{x00}

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296A52300000000}Heroes who have crossed the Cloud Sea
have joined us!

{C:81958296A72300000000}Comrades of White Valley!
Give them a warm welcome!!


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900B01}{C:81958296B90100000000}Aww, no!
You said you didn't believe it,
Jojo!

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296A82300000000}Things have changed.
I want to fight too.

{C:81958296A92300000000}The blacksmith {C:819782830400}Shulove{C:819782830000} told you about 
{C:819782830400}Galient{C:819782830000}'s location.
I want you to take me there.

{C:81900B01}{C:81958296BA0100000000}{C:819782830400}A Kurakku{C:819782830000} could have its lair
there, you know.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296AA2300000000}Don't worry.
I'll protect you.

{C:81900B01}{C:81958296BB0100000000}Then all right.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AB2300000000}(Huh? Where are Jojo
and the others going?)

{x00}

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296AD2300000000}I'm counting on you from here on.
I'll remain in White Valley
for a while.

{C:81958296AE2300000000}I must bring the people
of the valley together.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296AF2300000000}Yes, Azuves.




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900D01}{C:81958296B02300000000}Oh, it's you.
I'm glad
you found Azuves.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B32300000000}Just who are you?

{C:81900D01}{C:81958296B52300000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Hilmocha.{C:819782830000}
One thing's certain:
I'm on Jojo's side.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B72300000000}I'll believe you for now.
Being suspicious of people doesn't come naturally to me.

{C:81900D01}{C:81958296B92300000000}You're a good boy.
But the young ladies there
don't seem convinced.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296BA2300000000}I don't really...

{C:81900400}{C:81958296BB2300000000}I'm not convinced.
You're far too suspicious.

{C:81900D01}{C:81958296BD2300000000}Ahahaha! That's true.
Well, think whatever you like.
I'm not going to run or hide.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296BF2300000000}Then I will.



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296C02300000000}Um, it's Jojo, right?
What are you doing?

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296C12300000000}Oh, just something.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C22300000000}You're going to look
for that Gali-something, aren't you?

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296C32300000000}How did you know?!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296C52300000000}When you talk that loudly,
anyone can hear you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C62300000000}Could we come along too?
I'm a little curious.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296C72300000000}Sure, but
it might be a Kurakku's lair.
Are you still all right with that?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296C82300000000}What's a Kurakku?

{C:81900B01}{C:81958296BC0100000000}It's a really huge,
loooong creature.
It could swallow the likes of you in one gulp.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296C92300000000}What?!
Let's not go, big brother!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CA2300000000}It sounds interesting.
I'll go
with Jojo.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296CB2300000000}Then Nelfea and I
will wait here.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296CC2300000000}Huh? I'm waiting too?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CD2300000000}Sorry, Nelfea.
Stay here with Rie.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296CE2300000000}Yes, yes.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296CF2300000000}Then let's go.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900B01}{C:81958296BD0100000000}There's absolutely nothing here.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296D02300000000}Were we tricked?

{C:81900B01}{C:81958296BE0100000000}A little farther.
Let's try going just a little farther.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296D12300000000}Still, I'm impressed
that you two can walk normally
in a place like this.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296D22300000000}We've had different training.

{C:81900B01}{C:81958296BF0100000000}There's something written here.

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296D32300000000}You're right.


{x00}

{C:8193D101}{C:81958296662400000000}Thank you, Jojo.
But it's true.

{C:81958296672400000000}And...
what do you think happened?

{C:81930A01}{C:81958296682400000000}You won, right?

{C:8193D101}{C:81958296692400000000}It isn't a matter
of winning or losing.

{C:819582966A2400000000}I nearly killed
a dear friend with my own hands.
In fact, I came close to killing them.

{C:819582966B2400000000}Jojo, that's how dangerous it is
to have power
and let it go to your head.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900A01}{C:819582966C2400000000}Then what should I do...?

{C:81930100}{C:819582966D2400000000}Listen, Jojo.
Why don't you travel to the other continents... with us?

{C:81900A01}{C:819582966E2400000000}The other continents?

{C:81930100}{C:819582966F2400000000}Yes. We'll have Azuves
come with us too.

{C:81958296702400000000}He'll be able to see
how you grow
as a person.

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296712400000000}I also think that would be better
for learning all sorts of things.
What do you say?

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296722400000000}...I'll do it.
Yes! I'll go with you
and earn Grandpa's recognition!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296732400000000}Let's do our best, Jojo!

{C:81900A01}{C:81958296742400000000}It's good to be working with you again.

{C:8190D101}{C:81958296752400000000}Let's do our best together.




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900F01}{C:81958296772400000000}Ah, so these are the young heroes!

{C:81958296792400000000}I am {C:819782830400}Don Slarzen.{C:819782830000}
Until now,
I was wagging my tail for Mardoul.

{C:819582967B2400000000}But from now on,
I shall fight alongside you.

{C:81900E01}{C:819582967C2400000000}Lord Slarzen is a warrior like few others.
You can count on him, Jojo.

{C:81900F01}{C:819582967D2400000000}Such praise from the hero Azuves
makes me blush.
I shall do all I can for you.




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900400}{C:819582967E2400000000}Ah, there you are!
Come to the Astante.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967F2400000000}What's happened?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296802400000000}The people who seized Posaydal's ship
have come, but...
Anyway, could you come?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296812400000000}I'll be right there.



{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296842400000000}Ugwah!!

{C:8190A502}{C:81958296852400000000}Whoa! Himiko!
How many times do I have to tell you to stop?!
Um... Are you all right?


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296862400000000}Ugggh...
If she does that again, I might die.

{C:81958296872400000000}...
So, are you the ones
who took over a ship from Posaydal's army?

{C:8190A702}{C:81958296882400000000}That's right!
{C:819782830400}Wataru{C:819782830000} went bang, kaboom,
and rat-a-tat-tat-tat-tat!

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296892400000000}Hey, Himiko.
No one can understand an explanation like that.

{C:819582968A2400000000}In short, we defeated
the villains and seized their ship.
Now we're looking for allies.

{C:819582968B2400000000}Then we heard rumors about you,
and so we came here.
Will you fight alongside us?

{C:8190B901}{C:819582968C2400000000}Allow me to join you too.


{C:81900400}{C:819582968D2400000000}You're letting people this strange
join us?

{C:81930100}{C:819582968F2400000000}We need allies.
I'm sure we'll manage.

{C:81958296902400000000}Um, {C:819782830400}Shibaraku{C:819782830000},
I understand the situation.
Let's fight together.

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296922400000000}Yes. I'm counting on you.








{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900E01}{C:81958296932400000000}Are these...
your new comrades?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296942400000000}Yes, they are.
They're a little eccentric, though.

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296952400000000}Oh, yes, my thanks are overdue.
Thank you
for persuading Jojo.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296962400000000}No, that was thanks to Quatre.
I couldn't do anything.

{C:81900E01}{C:81958296972400000000}You're too modest.
As you suggested,
I shall go with Jojo as well.

{C:81958296982400000000}Slarzen, of course,
will do the same.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296992400000000}That's reassuring!
Thank you, Azuves.

{C:8190A502}{C:819582969B2400000000}Sorry to interrupt.
I noticed a little while ago,
and thought I should tell you the Cloud Sea has cleared.

{C:81930100}{C:819582969C2400000000}Nelfea!

{C:81900400}{C:819582969D2400000000}Prepare for departure, right?!

{C:81930100}{C:819582969E2400000000}I'm counting on you!




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:819582969F2400000000}We've suddenly gained so many more people again.
So, are we leaving already?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A02400000000}The Cloud Sea seems to have opened up,
so I'd like to get moving soon.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A12400000000}But there's just one problem.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296A22400000000}Apparently there are enemies overhead again.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A32400000000}We have more allies now.
I'm sure we'll manage.

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296A42400000000}Hold a moment!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A52400000000}Whoa, you startled me!
You were here?

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296A62400000000}Enemies overhead, you say?
I must call {C:819782830400}Senjinmaru{C:819782830000} at once!

{C:81900300}{C:81958296A72400000000}Senjinmaru?

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296A82400000000}Is there a public telephone nearby?

{C:81900400}{C:81958296AA2400000000}Of course there isn't
anything like that here!

{C:8190A802}{C:81958296AB2400000000}Oh, no!
That makes me completely useless!


{C:8190A702}{C:81958296AC2400000000}You mean a hippo?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AD2400000000}I can't deal with this.
Rie, let's go!


{x00}
